SenangStart CSS browser setup.description: Load SenangStart CSS 0.4.2 for zero-build attribute styling.

body: <section layout="${1:flex col center}" space="${2:p:big g:medium}" visual="${3:bg:primary text:white rounded:big}">
SenangStart CSS layout.description: Natural-language layout, spacing, and visual attributes. Requires SenangStart CSS.

SenangStart Icons browser setup.description: Register the ss-icon component with Icons 1.0.17.

SenangStart icon.description: Insert an icon component. Requires the Icons browser bundle.

SenangStart Actions browser setup.description: Load SenangStart Actions 0.1.7 after the document is parsed.

SenangStart Actions counter.description: Reactive state and event bindings. Requires SenangStart Actions.

SenangStart Actions toggle.description: Toggle content with reactive visibility and accessibility attributes. Requires Actions.

SenangStart Shapes browser setup.description: Register the ss-shape component with Shapes 0.1.2.

SenangStart shape.description: Insert a shape with a supported variant. Requires the Shapes browser bundle.

SenangStart pattern stylesheet.description: Load the Shapes 0.1.2 repeating background patterns; no JavaScript required.

SenangStart background pattern.description: Insert a repeating background. Requires the patterns stylesheet.

SenangStart XR browser setup.description: Load A-Frame before SenangStart XR 2.1.0. Use in plain HTML.

body: <a-sxr-flex-container flex-direction="column" justify-content="center" align-items="center" width="3" height="2" position="0 1.6 -2">
SenangStart XR scene.description: A minimal XR interface with a camera and interactive cursor. Requires A-Frame and XR.
